name: power-apps-canvas-mcp
description: Ground rules for Power Apps canvas apps through FlowStudio MCP: the canvas tools, edit sessions, draft versus live, and long calls and timeouts. Load this skill first for any canvas app work, before `power-apps-canvas-read`, `power-apps-canvas-edit` or `power-apps-canvas-ship`, and when a canvas call behaves strangely: a timeout that may still have created something, a push stuck importing, a session that moved, or draft-versus-live confusion. Requires a FlowStudio MCP subscription; see https://mcp.flowstudio.app
